sources.provider: Phi Kappa Psi Fraternity, The Shield
sources.title: The Shield of Phi Kappa Psi, vol. 47 nos. 1–5, 1926–27, complete issue PDF
sources.use: Primary historical source: “Indiana Delta’s New Home,” printed pp. 342–345. Text describes 1926 opening, triangular lot, L plan, orientation, three stories over basement, driveway, roof/brick/limestone and plaza; p.342 includes contemporary house photo.
sources.limits: The source documents the 1926 Phi Kappa Psi house, not the current Delta Sigma Phi occupant or all present materials. Article prose directions are not surveyed bearings; printed photograph is B&W, oblique, unscaled and partly obscured.
